business_summary.text: Lumax Auto Technologies is a diversified automotive systems provider specializing in Advanced Plastics, Mechatronics, and Alternate Fuels for 2W, 4W, and CV segments.

call_points.text: FY27 capex estimated at ₹300 Cr, focusing on Mechatronics and Alternate Fuels expansions.
Acquired remaining 15.97% stake in Lumax FAE in FY27, making it a wholly owned subsidiary.
Management kept the 20% revenue CAGR target for FY27-FY28, with about 15% organic and the rest inorganic.
FY28 EBITDA margin targeted at 15.5-16%, inclusive of other income, on about ₹1,000 Cr EBITDA.
Management walked back the 20% margin ambition, saying 17-17.5% over three to five years would be satisfactory.
The Manesar Mechatronics plant consolidating four entities is expected to be commissioned by Q3 of this year.
Mechatronics is guided at about ₹400 Cr revenue this fiscal and close to ₹1,000 Cr by FY2030-31.
Greenfuel won Mahindra's passenger-vehicle CNG delivery system business and will set up a Nashik plant.
Greenfuel's 23% Q1 margin included about ₹3 Cr one-off tooling revenue; normalised margin is 20%, guided at 19-20%.
Advanced Plastics, 56% of revenue, operates at 16-20% EBITDA margin and is expected to stay there.
Aftermarket grew only 6% in Q1 on non-lighting pricing pressure; management still guides double-digit for the rest of FY27.
Full-year capex for FY27 is projected to be between ₹275 crore and ₹300 crore.

operating_notes.text: NCLT New Delhi Bench approved the amalgamation of IAC International Automotive India with Lumax Auto Technologies with effect from October 1, 2025.
Recommended final dividend of ₹5.50 per share for FY25-26.
Order book of ₹1,600 Cr: Advanced Plastics ₹787 Cr, Mechatronics close to ₹500 Cr, Alternate Fuels ₹200 Cr, Structures and Control Systems ₹130 Cr.
IAC accounts for almost one third of the total order book, with a large share from Mahindra; IAC is about 60% of the Advanced Plastics division.
Mechatronics is only about 6-7% of the total revenue pie, which limited the impact of 30-50% electronics cost inflation.
Order book of ₹1,879 Cr with 29% from alternate powertrains (EV/CNG).
Content per vehicle in 4W increased to ₹70-75k, up ~5x in 5 years.
Advanced Plastics segment grew 44% YoY in Q2FY27 to ₹886 Cr.

timeline.summary: Lumax Auto Technologies announced that the NCLT New Delhi Bench reserved its order on the Second Motion petition for the amalgamation of IAC International Automotive India.
Lumax Auto Technologies approved the sale of its 50% stake in Lumax Jopp Allied Technologies to Jopp Holding GmbH for Rs. 1.52.5 lakh.
Lumax Auto Technologies announced that the NCLT New Delhi Bench approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of IAC International Automotive India on May 8, 2026.
On May 16, 2026, Lumax Auto Technologies announced that CRISIL Ratings reaffirmed its long-term and short-term credit ratings on enhanced bank loan facilities of ₹681 crore.

Lumax Auto Technologies Limited schedules Q4 & FY 2026 earnings call on June 1, 2026, at 3:00 PM IST with **Mr. Vikas Marwah (CEO), Mr. Anmol Jain (MD), Mr. Deepak Jain (Director), Mr. Sanjay Mehta (CFO & Group CFO), and others**.
Lumax Auto Technologies’ representatives will participate in an Analyst/Institutional Investor Meet with BofA India on June 02, 2026, at 09:00 AM at Bank of Taj Mahal America Palace, Mumbai.
Lumax Auto Technologies reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹1,042.39 Cr and recommended a final dividend of ₹5.50 per share.
Lumax Auto Technologies reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,870 Cr and PAT of ₹337 Cr, recommending a ₹5.50 per share dividend.
On June 1, 2026, Lumax Auto Technologies reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹1,417 crore and FY26 revenue of ₹4,870 crore during its earnings conference call.

On its 11 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, Lumax Auto Technologies reported revenue of ₹1,364 Cr (+33% YoY), EBITDA of ₹205 Cr (15.1% margin) and PAT of ₹99 Cr (+83%), with a ₹1,600 Cr order book and FY27 capex guided at ₹300 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,555.51 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹105.51 Cr.
On 24 October 2026, Lumax Auto Technologies reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,556 Cr (+35% YoY) and PAT of ₹117 Cr (+50% YoY).
Lumax Auto Technologies reported Q2FY27 revenue growth of 35% YoY and set a long-term revenue target of ₹11,000 Cr by FY31.
